old_html: XNA sets the inverse span to 0 below 1.4e-45 and returns the first key's value.
html: XNA sets the inverse span to 0 below 1.4e-45 and returns finite values: the first key's value for a position before the range and the last key's value after it.
why: The CNA-BUG-065 review re-derived XNA's all-coincident-keys behaviour (before the range the first key's value, after the range the last key's); the Deep Dive gave only the first half.
